notes: Stress variant: contract fields only (labels split at ': ' into label + amount, a label with no amount, ✓ outputs), rows revealed as they are passed, long 2-line labels, the counter starting at 1.0 s, a red (cost) counter, no captions, verdict auto (lands in the formula bar). Maths: FY2025 net interest $970B (the 10a teaser's sourced figure) ÷ 31,536,000 s = $30,758.50 a second (≈ $30,800). Counter 1.0-23.0 s: 30,758.5 × 22 = $676,687 (≈). Pass times = 1.0 + value ÷ 30,758.5: $1,251 (BLS median weekly pay) → 1.04 s; $65,052 (× 52) → 3.11 s; $393,700 (Census median new house) → 13.80 s; $500,000 → 17.26 s; $650,520 (10 × $65,052) → 22.15 s, i.e. ten years of median pay every ≈ 21 seconds (650,520 ÷ 30,758.5 = 21.15 s).
